title: Longest film per director country
statementMd:
For each director country, show the longest movie (title and runtime) made by a director from that country.

Expected columns: `country`, `title`, `runtime_minutes`.

Tables: `movies`, `directors`, `reviews`.

Row order does not matter.
hints: Compare runtime to the max per country.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT d.country, m.title, m.runtime_minutes FROM movies m JOIN directors d ON d.id = m.director_id WHERE m.runtime_minutes = (SELECT MAX(m2.runtime_minutes) FROM movies m2 JOIN directors d2 ON d2.id = m2.director_id WHERE d2.country = d.country);
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
